translations.SEEKVERA may earn a commission when a us: SEEKVERA may earn a commission when a user completes a qualifying purchase, booking, subscription or referral through certain tracked links. translations.SEEKVERA AI may refuse requests that inv: SEEKVERA AI may refuse requests that involve prohibited or illegal goods, services or content. translations.Weapons, ammunition, explosives, militar: Intwaro, amasasu, ibisasu, imyambaro ya gisirikare / abapolisi cyangwa ibikoresho byo kurwana, ubwambure bweruye / porunogarafiya cyangwa serivisi z’imibonano mpuzabitsina, ibiyobyabwenge bigenzurwa, ibicuruzwa byibwe / impimbano, inyandiko mpimbano, uburiganya / uburiganya, gucuruza, ibikoresho by’intagondwa / iterabwoba, gukoresha ubuzima bwite, n’ibindi bicuruzwa cyangwa serivisi bitemewe.
